events.title: We extended the demo — thank you
events.summary: It has been four days since Next Fest started, and honestly we did not expect this much interest. Far more people tried the game than we hoped, and a lot of you played the demo all the way to the end. Every piece of feedback and every bug report reached us — thank you. So many of you finished the demo and asked "is there more?" that we decided to extend it. events.title: Steam Next Fest is here and the Chest & Blade demo is live ⚔️
events.summary: Hello everyone, and welcome! Our closed beta ended in September. Today the doors open to all of you: the Chest & Blade demo is live for Steam Next Fest. It's free on our Steam page and it stays up until October 26. If you were in the beta, thank you. If you're just finding us, you're right on time. What you'll play Pick Warrior, Mage or Barbarian and set out. Your hero fights on its own, and you're the one building it. Clear the stages, crack open chests, upgrade your gear. events.title: CLOSED BETA IS LIVE! ⚔️
events.summary: Hello! The Chest & Blade Closed Beta has officially begun. The game we've been working on for so long is now being tested together with real players. If you'd like to experience Chest & Blade early and help shape its development, our doors are open. To play, just join our Discord server and ask for a beta key.
